visual_brief: Merdeka 118 is a slender blue-glass tower with large diamond-shaped facets, an asymmetric sloping crown and an exceptionally long needle spire. It rises beside Stadium Merdeka and Stadium Negara in central Kuala Lumpur; elevated city views and views across the stadium precinct best reveal its full silhouette. Distinguish it from the paired, stepped Petronas Towers, the bulb-headed KL Tower and the boxy crowned Exchange 106.
notes: Seven distinct photographs retained; recommended c7, with c1 as the daylight alternative. All exceed 2400 px on the long side. Some alternatives have shadowed or partially obscured bases; details are recorded individually.
